title: How to Properly Store and Practice with Your Byrna Launcher
summary: Learn how to properly store and practice with your Byrna launcher, including safe staging, secure storage, and training tips to build confidence and preparedness.
body_markdown:
## How to Safely Stage and Train with a Byrna Launcher at Home


Personal safety preparedness isn't just about owning a self-defense tool—it's about knowing how and where to safely store it and developing the skills to use it effectively. For Byrna owners, proper staging and consistent training can help ensure a launcher is accessible when needed while remaining secure around children and other unauthorized users.


### Safe Staging Starts with Smart Placement


Storing and staging a[Byrna launcher](https://byrna.com/collections/byrna-non-lethal-guns) are two related but different concepts. Safe storage means keeping the launcher secured away from immature or unauthorized hands. Staging means placing it in an area where it can be accessed when circumstances require it.


Consider the places where time is most often spent and where a safety concern could realistically arise. A nightstand near the bed, a secure location in a home office, or an appropriate area inside a vehicle may make sense depending on individual circumstances and applicable laws and policies.


A small locking case can provide an additional layer of security while keeping a launcher accessible to authorized, mature users. Some locking cases can also be secured to sturdy furniture or a vehicle using a steel cable.


### Training Builds Confidence and Competence


Having a Byrna nearby is only part of being prepared. Training is critical because a self-defense tool should never be used for the first time during an active threat.


Byrna launchers provide opportunities for hands-on practice in appropriate settings. Users can become familiar with the launcher's handling, trigger, CO2 system, sound, and projectiles while following all applicable safety instructions.


Training can also incorporate realistic, scenario-based exercises using appropriate training equipment. Practicing regularly helps develop familiarity and confidence before a stressful situation ever occurs.


### Prepare Before the Moment Arrives


Effective preparedness combines


**safe storage, thoughtful staging, and consistent training** . By considering where a launcher may be needed, securing it appropriately, and developing proficiency through regular practice, Byrna owners can build a more responsible approach to personal safety.


Preparedness is most effective when it happens before it's needed.
